artworks.title: Perseus and Andromeda
artworks.description: Titian's poesie: Andromeda chained to the rock as Perseus dives sword-first at the sea-monster — the Ethiopian rescue as Venetian storm of flesh and foam.

artworks.title: Perseus Freeing Andromeda
artworks.description: Rubens shows the chains giving way: Andromeda steps into Perseus' arms while putti and the slain monster fill the shore.

artworks.title: Andromeda Chained to the Rocks
artworks.description: Rembrandt isolates the princess alone on the rock — no Perseus yet, only the chain that waits for the monster Cassiopeia's boast has summoned.

artworks.title: Andromeda Chained to the Rock by the Nereids
artworks.description: Chassériau paints the Nereids binding Andromeda to the cliff before the rescue — the sacrifice the city demands, staged for the Louvre.

films.title: Clash of the Titans
films.description: Harryhausen's Perseus frees Andromeda from the sea-beast — the rescue that fixed the myth for a generation of screens.
